section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the decree in the absolute will for the revealed will to be aroused specifically through an arousal from below ensures that G-d's kingship over the worlds also comes from the worlds themselves, and it connects this to the mitzvah of shofar, where the arousal from below is the mitzvah itself and the absolute will is drawn through the self-nullification of the soul's essence.
section.t: And it can be said,
that this which was decreed in the absolute will, that the arousal of the revealed will should be specifically through an arousal from below,
is,
so that His kingship over the worlds will be
(also)
from the perspective of the worlds.
[And analogous to how it is in an earthly kingdom,
that through the kingship being established by the coronation of the people,
"You shall surely set a king over you,"
the people's self-nullification to the king is from the perspective of their own existence.]
And based on this, the connection of "Make Me king over you"
(also)
to the mitzvah of shofar blowing will be understood,
for the fulfillment of the mitzvah of shofar blowing is the arousal from below that arouses the revealed will.
For the self-nullification from the perspective of the essence of the soul in shofar blowing
is not an arousal from below to arouse the revealed will,
because the concept of an arousal from below is that the service of the lower one
(existence)
arouses the drawing down.
Therefore, both aspects are needed.
That the arousal from below which arouses the revealed will is the fulfillment of the mitzvah of shofar blowing.
And the drawing down of the absolute will
[that this, that through an arousal from below the revealed will is aroused, is because it was so decreed in the absolute will]
is through the self-nullification from the perspective of the essence of the soul in shofar blowing.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that within the absolute will there are two aspects: one relating to the revealed will, which is the wondrous ability of the Essence of Ein Sof to be aroused by something incomparable, and the absolute will itself, which stems from the choice of the Essence.
section.t: And behold, even in the absolute will there are two aspects.
As it is in relation to the revealed will,
that through the drawing down of the absolute will, the revealed will is aroused by an arousal from below, even though the arousal from below is incomparable,
for this matter is the wonder of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is not defined by any definition, and it is within His ability that the arousal should also be through something that is incomparable
[and analogous to what was explained above
(section 5)
regarding the concept of wonder,
that the wonder is that which is not defined, and it is within His ability to descend below].
And the absolute will itself,
which is from the perspective of the choice of the Essence.
For that it was decreed by Him to will thus is not because through this His wonder is revealed,
but rather that He so chose in His free choice.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in shofar blowing there are three general aspects: the mitzvah which is the arousal from below for the revealed will, the aspect of teshuvah which draws the wonder of the Essence of Ein Sof, and the revelation of the soul's essence which draws the absolute will itself.
section.t: And it can be said,
that this is that in shofar blowing there are three aspects
(in general).
The mitzvah within it,
the aspect of teshuvah,
and the inner self-nullification from the perspective of the essence of the soul.
That the fulfillment of the mitzvah of shofar blowing is the arousal from below that arouses the revealed will
(as above).
And through the teshuvah of shofar blowing,
for the aspect of teshuvah is that one goes out from his limitations,
the wonder is drawn
(without limit)
that is in the Essence of Ein Sof,
that the arousal
(of the revealed will)
is through something that is incomparable,
the absolute will that pertains to the revealed will.
And through the revelation of the essence of the soul that comes through shofar blowing, the absolute will itself is drawn,
the choice of the Essence.
